hero_signature: Bottom-anchored content over a full-bleed plated-dish photo at opacity-80 with a charcoal/40 overlay. The headline is italic Playfair Display at 5xl-8xl with a fade-up entrance. Two CTAs underneath: burgundy filled 'Reserve a Table' and bone-outlined 'View Menu' (which inverts on hover).

section_flow.notes: Fixed nav. On home (transparent prop) it starts transparent over the dark hero — bone wordmark + bone links — then swaps to a light bone background with shadow once scrollY > 24. On all other pages it always renders in the light style.
4:5 grayscale-on-hover photo left. Right: Playfair display section heading + drop-cap first paragraph in burgundy + second paragraph standard.
Stripped-down 4-col interior photo grid (each tile aspect-[4/5] with hover scale-105).
Dark charcoal section with bone text. Map placeholder card left. Right: 'Visit' address + clickable phone/email + 'Hours' weekday table.
Top: 4 dietary chips (All/Vegan/GF/DF). Below: accordions per course (First/Main/Wine). Each item row has name + description + dietary tags + price aligned right. Filter narrows items in place.
3 tabs (Cellar/Terrace/Chef's Counter) drive an image + capacity card swap. Below: contact form + interactive guest-count stepper (+/- buttons updating an integer between 2 and 200).
3-col article grid (image / date kicker / Playfair title / 1-line body). Underneath: bone newsletter signup with burgundy submit.
Centered serif heading + 2-col form: name, email, date, time select, party size, special requests. Burgundy full-width CTA 'Request Table'.
Dark charcoal bg, bone-tinted text. Brand wordmark + address + phone, social links (Instagram/Facebook/Resy), copyright.

notable_features: Drop-cap first paragraph styling with burgundy initial (via ::first-letter)
Multi-page Next.js App Router routes (Home/Menu/Events/Journal/Reservations) instead of show/hide SPA logic
Dietary chip filter on menu accordion with empty-state messaging per course
Multi-room private-dining tabs driving image + capacity card swap
Guest-count stepper (+/-) for event inquiry form
Burgundy CTA pill (rounded-full) paired with bone-outlined secondary CTAs that invert on hover
Italic Playfair Display all headlines, 5xl-8xl on hero
Charcoal/40 overlay on hero photo for readable bone text
Grayscale-to-color hover on the story-section photo
motion_vocabulary: Reveal: opacity 0->1 + y 24->0 over 700ms with [0.22,1,0.36,1] easing, once-only on viewport-enter
Hero entrance: opacity 0->1 + y 24->0 over 1s, ease editorial
Story photo hover: grayscale -> color over 700ms
Menu accordion summary toggle: + rotates to × via group-open:rotate-45 over 300ms
Room tabs: border-burgundy underline + text-color transition on active button
Reservation/event forms: bottom-border focus -> burgundy transition over 300ms
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce -> all transitions clamped to 0.01ms
tailwind_extras_inline_css: .drop-cap (4.5rem burgundy italic first-letter). .form-input-sk (transparent bottom-border 30%-charcoal input that turns burgundy on focus). Tokens: --color-bone, --color-charcoal, --color-burgundy, --color-warmgold, --font-display (Playfair Display), --font-sans (Inter). H1-H4 default to display font globally.
